free_tier.stated: No free allowance is stated. Sign in with an email 6-digit code, then buy prepaid USD credits in the console; per-request pricing is metered against a live price sheet.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: an OpenAI-compatible base URL with streaming, tool calling and open-model presets
chaining: the prepaid credit purchase is the scarce link; there is no standing free tier

limits.value: prepaid USD credits metered against a live per-model price sheet

identity_cost.detail: sign in with an email address and a 6-digit code, then buy prepaid credits; no password

reliability_note: no content logging by default; limited operational metadata retained for abuse prevention and billing; no TEE, E2EE or confidential-compute guarantee yet

evidence.proved: sign-in is a 6-digit email code with no password; making requests then requires buying prepaid credits
evidence.quote: Sign in with your email — we send a 6-digit code, no password — then buy prepaid credits in the console to start making requests.

notes: no standing free text allowance; an email code is needed to sign in and prepaid credits to make requests
